svg.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'SF Pro Text', 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: iPadOS · Interval grading viewer · Presets · landscape
svg.desc: Mirrors the iPad LANDSCAPE editor (a regular-width window wider than tall): App/PhotoViewerView.swift `floatingEditorBody(in:)` — `floatingPictureFrame(in:)` anchors the picture top-left at the size its aspect gives it inside the safe area (a tall picture fills the height, a wide one the width); `touchChrome(showsBadge:)` puts the 36 pt back disc (and, on an interval shoot, the INTERVAL chip — App/EditorControls/EditorMarqueeBadge.swift) top-left and App/EditorControls/EditorTabPill.swift top-right, both 12 pt under the status bar; `floatingFootRow` seats App/EditorControls/EditorGroupBar.swift (`.padPill`, six 58 pt cells) bottom-right and, with a timeline, the compact App/GradeTimelineView.swift strip in a 66 pt capsule bottom-left, both 16 pt off the safe area's foot; `floatingPanel(in:)` floats App/PhotoAdjustmentsPanel.swift (`layout: .floating`, `style: .dark`) as a 400 pt card at right 16 / bottom 96 — above the buttons — draggable by its header (grab bar + title row, `floatingHeaderDragged`, clamped on screen by `clampedFloatingOffset`, the seat kept across groups for the session) and pinned top 62 / bottom 96 when the group is Presets. Pinch, double-tap and trackpad zoom release the picture from its anchor (≤ 1.03× snaps home; a '2.5× · tap to fit' pill then follows the back disc) — desc-only here. iPad PORTRAIT is NOT this layout and not the phone's either: it takes the dark rail (`railBody`, settled 2026-09-13 over spec decision 9), undrawn. Tokens: ground #000, chrome rgba(28,28,30,.85–.86) over .ultraThinMaterial, amber #FFB340 for every highlight, #8E8E93 secondary, diamond #FFB340 with a #C36A00 ring. Geometry measured on an iPad Pro 11-inch (M4) simulator (1210×834 pt) on 2026-09-13 and carried to this 1180×820 canvas: left- and top-anchored positions transfer, trailing ones sit 30 pt further left and foot ones 14 pt higher here; the simulator's safe area is 24 top / 25 bottom, this canvas assumes 24 / 20. THIS FILE is the Presets group: `floatingPanel` pins the card top 62 / bottom 96 / right 16 (`padding` on a `.frame(maxHeight: .infinity)`), so it runs from 62 pt under the safe area's top — the tab pill's foot plus 8 — to the same 96 pt seat as every other group, 400 pt wide, and the header is NOT a drag handle here (`onHeaderDrag` is nil for Presets). Content: a vertical ScrollView of a 4-column LazyVGrid (spacing 10 rows / 8 columns; PhotoAdjustmentsPanel `presetsContent`, `.floating`) of EditorPresetThumbnail tiles (App/EditorControls/PresetTile.swift `.padGrid`): square, (368 − 24) ÷ 4 = 86 pt, radius 12, the frame under the playhead rendered through PhotoGrader at each built-in preset with NEUTRAL adjustments (App/EditorControls/PresetThumbnails.swift — the tap's honest preview, settled 2026-09-13: applying a built-in replaces the edits), 11 pt semibold name 5 pt below in #8E8E93, 115 pt row pitch; then the owner's Lightroom card and 'Save these edits as a preset?' offer when it has them, then the Save as Preset row (square.and.arrow.down + 13 pt semibold, amber). PhotoPreset.strip's five built-ins — Natural · Cinema · Matte · Vivid · Original — then every CustomPresetStore preset; the simulator library had none, so row two holds Original alone. Header: 'Presets' then the state pill 'Edited' (24 pt, white 12 %, 13 pt semibold #B4B4B8 — the Preset state row's pill, PresetState.edited) and the amber 6 pt dot (the look is not Original). DEVIATIONS FROM BOARD 5a, drawn as the app ships them (2026-09-13, screens/ipad-presets.png): the board shows no Edited pill and no Save as Preset row, and rings the NAMED preset's tile in amber regardless of edits (Natural here) — since 2026-09-13 the app rings the BASE built-in preset the edits started from (Natural here, amber ring + amber name) while the pill reads Edited — Original never rings while Edited, and a custom preset rings only while named; drawn that way. Buttons pill: Presets open. Staged by LL_EDITOR=latest LL_VIEWER=1 LL_KEYFRAMES=sunset LL_SECTIONS=presets on an iPad Pro 11-inch simulator.
svg.text: iPadOS · Interval grading viewer · Presets · landscape · 1180×820 pt
mirrors App/PhotoViewerView.swift floatingPanel (pinned top 62 / bottom 96) + PhotoAdjustmentsPanel presetsContent (4-column grid) — LL_EDITOR=latest LL_SECTIONS=presets
